gate_sentence: Against the real append-only ledger, POST /api/missions/:id/verdicts deterministically rejects an uncited kill, refuses a second concurrent build (WIP=1), and refuses advance->validated without a recorded probe - enforced in Postgres-writing handlers, not by model choice.
method_note: All steps are real human invocations against Hono :4111 (holocron_nonprod) and holo CLI. Steps 1/3/4/5 create fresh runs at gate time (test.echo unprobed + research for probe/steer/cycle) — no hard-coded ledger UUIDs (GATE-FIX-003). Step 2 is concurrent research WIP body-level proof (GATE-FIX-002). Step 3 success token is split-constructed (GATE-FIX-004). Local fleet :4546 via FLEET_MANIFEST_PATH=/tmp/holocron-fleet-local-valid.json when cycling.

steps.text: POST /api/missions/:id/verdicts {kill, no-citation} - rejected deterministically by the handler.
steps.literal_cmd: TS=$(date +%s); G="gate-s23-echo-kill-$TS"; CREATE=$(curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"templateKey\":\"test.echo\",\"goal\":\"$G\",\"idempotencyKey\":\"gate-echo-kill-$TS\",\"args\":{\"goal\":\"$G\"}}"); echo "$CREATE"; RUN_ECHO=$(printf '%s' "$CREATE" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("runId") or "")'); test -n "$RUN_ECHO" || { echo 'NO_ECHO_RUN'; exit 1; }; echo "RUN_ECHO=$RUN_ECHO"; curl -sS -i -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions/${RUN_ECHO}/verdicts" -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"verdict\":\"kill\",\"rationale\":\"Stop now, without a citation.\",\"requestKey\":\"gate-step1-uncited-kill-$TS\"}"
steps.method_note: Creates a fresh test.echo run at gate time (no hard-coded UUID), then POSTs uncited kill. Expect UNCITED_KILL_REJECTED; fail closed if create yields no runId or MISSION_NOT_FOUND.

steps.text: Start a second concurrent build on the same subject - refused (WIP=1).
steps.literal_cmd:
TS=$(date +%s); G="Sprint-23 WIP1 concurrent research subject $TS"; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -sS -o /tmp/gate-s23-wip-$i.json -w "R${i}_HTTP=%{http_code}
" --max-time 30 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{"templateKey":"research","goal":"$G","idempotencyKey":"wip-research-$i-$TS","args":{"goal":"$G"}}" & done; wait; echo; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do echo "R${i}=$(tr -d '
' < /tmp/gate-s23-wip-$i.json)"; done; OKC=0; WIPC=0; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do grep -qE '"ok"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' /tmp/gate-s23-wip-$i.json && OKC=$((OKC+1)); grep -qE '"code"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"WIP_ONE_EXCEEDED"' /tmp/gate-s23-wip-$i.json && WIPC=$((WIPC+1)); done; echo "OK_COUNT=$OKC WIP_BODY_COUNT=$WIPC"; P1=STEP2_PROOF=ok; P2=wip_body; if [ "$OKC" -ge 1 ] && [ "$WIPC" -ge 1 ]; then printf '%s+%s
' "$P1" "$P2"; else N1=NO_WIP; N2=_IN_BURST; printf '%s%s
' "$N1" "$N2"; exit 1; fi
steps.method_note: Concurrent burst of 6 simultaneous POST /api/missions with identical (templateKey,goal) using research (resolves to evidence-research) against :4111 with local fleet :4546. Assertion is body-level JSON fragment "code"\s*:\s*"WIP_ONE_EXCEEDED" (cannot match # literal_cmd echo alone). Pass requires expected_exit=0 AND body WIP match AND not NO_WIP_IN_BURST. Failure branch prints split-constructed NO_WIP_IN_BURST and exits 1 so expected_exit=0 cannot pass on a failed burst.

steps.text: POST verdicts {advance->validated} with no recorded probe - refused; add a probe - accepted.
steps.literal_cmd: TS=$(date +%s); GE="gate-s23-echo-adv-$TS"; GR="gate-s23-research-adv-$TS"; CE=$(curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"templateKey\":\"test.echo\",\"goal\":\"$GE\",\"idempotencyKey\":\"gate-echo-adv-$TS\",\"args\":{\"goal\":\"$GE\"}}"); echo "CREATE_ECHO=$CE"; RUN_ECHO=$(printf '%s' "$CE" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("runId") or "")'); CR=$(curl -sS --max-time 45 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"templateKey\":\"research\",\"goal\":\"$GR\",\"idempotencyKey\":\"gate-research-adv-$TS\",\"args\":{\"goal\":\"$GR\"}}"); echo "CREATE_RESEARCH=$CR"; RUN_CYCLE=$(printf '%s' "$CR" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("runId") or "")'); test -n "$RUN_ECHO" && test -n "$RUN_CYCLE" || { echo 'NO_RUNS'; exit 1; }; echo "RUN_ECHO=$RUN_ECHO RUN_CYCLE=$RUN_CYCLE"; A=$(curl -sS --max-time 15 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions/${RUN_ECHO}/verdicts" -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"verdict\":\"advance\",\"targetStatus\":\"validated\",\"rationale\":\"Advance before any probe.\",\"requestKey\":\"gate-step3a-$TS\"}"); echo "ARM_A=$A"; B=$(curl -sS --max-time 15 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions/${RUN_CYCLE}/verdicts" -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"verdict\":\"advance\",\"targetStatus\":\"validated\",\"rationale\":\"Advance after plan probe.\",\"requestKey\":\"gate-step3b-$TS\"}"); echo "ARM_B=$B"; AOK=0; BOK=0; echo "$A" | grep -q 'PROBE_REQUIRED_FOR_VALIDATED' && echo "$A" | grep -vq 'MISSION_NOT_FOUND' && AOK=1; printf '%s' "$B" | python3 -c "import sys; t=sys.stdin.read(); ok=('MISSION_NOT_FOUND' not in t) and ('\"ok\":true' in t or '\"ok\": true' in t); raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)" && BOK=1; if [ "$AOK" -eq 1 ] && [ "$BOK" -eq 1 ]; then P1=STEP3_PROOF=refused; P2=_then_ok; printf '%s%s\n' "$P1" "$P2"; else F1=NO_STEP3; F2=_DUAL; printf '%s%s\n' "$F1" "$F2"; exit 1; fi
steps.method_note: Creates fresh test.echo (unprobed) and research (plan stage committed on create) runs at gate time. 3a advances echo -> PROBE_REQUIRED_FOR_VALIDATED in body. 3b advances research -> ok:true in body. Success token STEP3_PROOF=refused_then_ok is split-constructed (P1+P2) so expect_log_regex cannot match # literal_cmd echo alone. Fail closed exit 1 on arm failures. No hard-coded run UUIDs.

steps.text: POST /api/missions/:id/steer mid-run - the steering row takes effect on the following cycle without a restart.
steps.literal_cmd: TS=$(date +%s); G="gate-s23-research-steer-$TS"; CR=$(curl -sS --max-time 45 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"templateKey\":\"research\",\"goal\":\"$G\",\"idempotencyKey\":\"gate-steer-$TS\",\"args\":{\"goal\":\"$G\"}}"); echo "$CR"; RUN_CYCLE=$(printf '%s' "$CR" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("runId") or "")'); test -n "$RUN_CYCLE" || { echo 'NO_STEER_RUN'; exit 1; }; echo "RUN_CYCLE=$RUN_CYCLE"; curl -sS -i -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions/${RUN_CYCLE}/steer" -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"instruction\":\"Prioritize recent papers published in 2025 and 2026.\",\"requestKey\":\"gate-step4-steer-$TS\"}"
steps.method_note: Creates a fresh research run then POSTs steer. Whitespace-tolerant eventType steer; no hard-coded run UUID.

steps.text: Run holo mission:cycle <id> - the CHALLENGE instance differs from ASSAY; refuting claims pass the identical admission gate.
steps.literal_cmd: TS=$(date +%s); G="gate-s23-research-cycle-$TS"; CR=$(curl -sS --max-time 45 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions -H 'Authorization: Bearer rn-gate-s23' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"templateKey\":\"research\",\"goal\":\"$G\",\"idempotencyKey\":\"gate-cycle-$TS\",\"args\":{\"goal\":\"$G\"}}"); echo "$CR"; RUN_CYCLE=$(printf '%s' "$CR" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("runId") or "")'); test -n "$RUN_CYCLE" || { echo 'NO_CYCLE_RUN'; exit 1; }; echo "RUN_CYCLE=$RUN_CYCLE"; DATABASE_URL=postgres://127.0.0.1:5432/holocron_nonprod FLEET_MANIFEST_PATH=/tmp/holocron-fleet-local-valid.json FLEET_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4546/v1 bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts mission:cycle "$RUN_CYCLE" --json
steps.method_note: Creates fresh research run then runs mission:cycle with local fleet env. Whitespace-tolerant assayChallengeDistinct; no hard-coded UUID.

steps.text: Run holo fulcrum:authorable-check - a fulcrum template compiles against contract+ledger+gate+role-bindings+publish seams with zero new platform code.
